تشتعلوا (form VIII)
# تَشْتَعِلُوا (taštaʕilū) /taʃ.ta.ʕi.luː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِشْتَعَلَ (ištaʕala)
# تُشْتَعَلُوا (tuštaʕalū) /tuʃ.ta.ʕa.luː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِشْتَعَلَ (ištaʕala)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
